CARD
**Still not ready**

This PR is meant to stop a scheduled message that was already sent from also being marked as failed when a later step errors. The idea is small, but the PR now shows 123 changed files with thousands of unrelated lines, so it can't be reviewed as it stands.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ℹ️  | The squash replaced the 6 earlier commits with 1, but the PR grew from +46/-11 in 2 files to +4994/-5409 in 123 files. It now includes unrelated web, docs, corporate and tooling files, which looks like a bad rebase or merge from main. |
| ❌  | The unrelated changes must be removed so the PR contains only the scheduled-message fix and its test. |
| ⚠️  | The author did not run the tests locally and relied on CI. With this diff, a passing CI doesn't show the fix is tested. |
| ⚠️  | There is no linked issue, and the author has no merged PRs. The author said this came from reading the code, not from a "help wanted" issue. |
| ✅  | The description now explains the change, and the self-review checklist is filled in. |

**Reviewer:** None yet. The PR is not ready for a maintainer.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and don't assign a reviewer until the diff is back to the intended files.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for squashing! The PR now shows 123 changed files, which looks like a bad rebase or merge from main. Could you reset the branch so it contains only your scheduled-message fix and its test (about 2 files)? The [guide on submitting a pull request](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/reviewable-prs.html) and the [commit discipline guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/commit-discipline.html) cover how to do that.
```
